title_en: For sale - Apartment 1+1 at the new Maternity
description_en: The apartment is located very close to Bryl, in front of the New Maternity Hospital. It is located on the 8th floor (not the last) well-managed building, with an elevator. Net area 57.4 m2, gross area 63 m2. It has 1 bedroom, 1 living room, 1 bathroom, 1 balcony. It can be bought with a loan.
